stem.text: Which graph represents the variation in electronegativity for Period 3 elements?

A.alt: Graph of electronegativity against element Na to Cl: a steep fall from Na, then a levelling decrease to Cl.

B.alt: Graph of electronegativity against element Na to Cl: a steady rise from Na to Cl.

C.alt: Graph of electronegativity against element Na to Cl: overall rise with dips at Al and S.

D.alt: Graph of electronegativity against element Na to Cl: sharp peak at Al, then zero at P, S and Cl.
